component.name: WiFi Analyzer
component.summary: Inspect nearby Wi-Fi networks and channels

description.p: WiFi Analyzer shows nearby wireless networks, their signal strength, channel and security mode.

screenshot.caption: Compare nearby Wi-Fi networks and channel overlap.

description.p: Improve Wi-Fi security classification, protect identifiable exports, and refine channel recommendations using local regulatory limits and reported channel widths. Add accessible controls and clearer connection diagnostics.

Förbättra klassningen av Wi-Fi-säkerhet, skydda exporter med identifierande uppgifter och förfina kanalrekommendationer efter lokala regler och rapporterad kanalbredd. Förbättra tillgängligheten och förtydliga anslutningsdiagnostiken.
Make saved signal-history charts accessible with a text summary and recent measurements.
Gör diagrammet över sparad signalhistorik tillgängligt med en textbeskrivning och en lista över de senaste mätningarna.
Improve release verification when CI checks out a tag without a local tag reference.
Förbättra releasekontrollen när CI checkar ut en tagg utan en lokal taggreferens.
Escape untrusted values in diagnostic reports, restrict Flatpak permissions to the reviewed set, and strengthen release and package verification.
Escapa osäkra värden i felsökningsrapporter, begränsa Flatpak-behörigheterna till den granskade uppsättningen och förbättra kontrollerna av releaser och paket.
Use the active NetworkManager Wi-Fi adapter for connection link-rate diagnostics when multiple adapters are available.
Prefer the Wi-Fi adapter connected through NetworkManager and read active-link details from the matching interface when multiple adapters are available.
Respect locally reported regulatory frequency ranges when recommending channels.
Clarify that channel overlap scores are scan-based estimates and do not measure client traffic or hidden networks.
Prevent formula injection from untrusted network names in CSV exports.
Add Occitan and German translations and clarify partial catalogue behavior.
Use the exact GitHub repository slug in the application ID.
Match the desktop application ID to the GitHub repository slug.
Add keyboard navigation and screen-reader support to the channel graph.
Prepare PyPI distribution and synchronize release metadata.
Fix direct launch with Python from the source directory.
Add zoom and guidance to the interactive channel view.
Add interactive channel filtering and expanded connection diagnostics.
Add a profile-scoped local signal history graph for selected access points.
Show the measured active-link Wi-Fi generation in the network list.
Fix channel detection, safe scan handling, filtered exports, package support, a Swedish manual, and active-link Wi-Fi generation identification.
Add a new WiFi Analyzer logo and desktop application icon.
Add a 20-language gettext translation framework and compile translations in Flatpak builds.
Add actionable system notifications for Wi-Fi connection problems.
Add interference explanations, connection diagnostics, profile history, and monitoring notifications.
Add location profiles and optional background scan monitoring with change notifications.
Add active-connection details, scan comparison, measured channel width, anonymized exports, and HTML diagnostic reports.
Add congestion recommendations, local scan history, CSV/JSON export, sorting, and access-point details.
Add filtering, 6 GHz support, channel-width guidance, and DFS/regulatory indications.
